scope: Report geometric mean over fixed suite and per-operation gains; do not claim every operation gains 10%. All stdout/stderr/request/config contracts must match.
startup_control: Same binary 20 repetitions, 3 warmups, A/A SQL CPU ratio 0.981 and RSS 1.001; version CPU ratio 1.077 and RSS 1.003
hardware_counter_control: perf stat taskset CPU2, 20 repeats; baseline version 1,840,535 user instructions +/-0.01%; round1 918,709 +/-0.01%
measurement_limitation: Shared host with unrelated workloads. No builds during final measurements. Full synthetic harness finished as timing started; no test processes remained when affinity isolation was applied. Measurements use CPUs 2,4,6,8 to avoid hybrid-core migration.
